title: Historical Design Snapshot: VibeX
supersededReason: Current frontend design is governed by the macOS Tahoe rules in DESIGN.md and docs/specs/tahoe-design-system-convergence.

display.purpose: App-level titles and welcome headings only.

body.purpose: Dense product copy, settings descriptions, and list content.

mono.purpose: Paths, branches, terminal data, and code references.

shadows.name: card-low
shadows.purpose: Repeated session cards and compact list items.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, active, and focus state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default committed action in dialogs, settings, and task workflows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: #5b8cc7; color: #f8fafc; font: 500 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; transition: background 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4d7eb8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(91, 140, 199, 0.24); }

components.name: Ghost Toolbar Button
components.description: Toolbar and rail action that stays quiet until hover or active state.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #7e8790; font: 500 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #242936; border-color: #dde1e7; background: #eef0f4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(91, 140, 199, 0.18); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact field for settings, command surfaces, and URL entry.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 240px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #dde1e7; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #4f5a63; font: 400 14px/20px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7e8790; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #c6ced8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(91, 140, 199, 0.14); }

components.name: Session Card
components.description: Repeated session item for sidebars and Kanban session hub.
components.css: .ds-session-card { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #dde1e7; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #4f5a63; box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(20, 31, 48, 0.075); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-session-card strong { color: #242936; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-session-card span { color: #7e8790; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-session-card:hover { background: #f8fafc; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 31, 48, 0.06); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter, count, and compact status marker.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #dde1e7; border-radius: 999px; background: #eef0f4; color: #7e8790; font: 500 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Historical 2026-05-25 generated snapshot. Use DESIGN.md as the single current source of truth for Tahoe design, Liquid Glass boundaries, Windows compatibility, and active migration rules.
keyCharacteristics: Dense information, quiet surfaces, visible state.
Light mode is the primary working scene; dark mode is supported for code-heavy or low-light sessions.
Blue accent is functional: selected, focused, primary, or live state only.
Panels are layered by border, tonal surface, and small shadows, not by decorative glass.
Typography is compact, fixed scale, and developer-readable.

rules.name: The State-Only Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is for selected, focused, primary, or live state. It is not decorative fill.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels are flat at rest unless they are floating above another layer.

dos: Do use the tokenized shell classes in frontend/src/styles/legacy/index.css before adding new one-off Tailwind color stacks.
Do keep product controls compact: 32px dense controls, 40px default controls, 8px default card radius.
donts: Don't use generic AI SaaS dashboard patterns: oversized cards, decorative gradients, glass panels, and vague productivity claims.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px on cards, callouts, list items, markdown blocks, or file tree rows.
